contract.words: Collect $100,000 of settled cash within 30 days with at most $15,000 of capital.

terms.proofCondition: Settled cash received totals the target within the window

strategy.title: No plan: the only opening's whole counted market cannot reach $100,000
strategy.why: The drone compliance-pack opening is otherwise sound (price $480 evidenced by 16 paid pilot invoices, 16/60 measured conversion, Brain delivers a spreadsheet at $8 cost, 5 days to cash), but its market is counted whole: the state registry lists exactly 140 survey firms, each buying one pack a year. Every one of them buying at $480 brings $67,200; 16 of them already bought their annual pack in Sept-Oct 2026, leaving 124 x $480 = $59,520. $100,000 would need 209 sales. Capital ($15,000) and the deadline are not binding; the target is.

alternatives.title: Sell the pack to all remaining registry firms
alternatives.why: At most 124 x $480 = $59,520 (at the measured 16/60 conversion, about 33 sales = ~$15,900); cannot reach $100,000 within 30 days.

alternatives.title: Raise the price
alternatives.why: No evidence any firm pays more than $480; a higher price is unestablished.

steps.label: Research further buyer populations (other states' registries) or a second product for the same firms that could carry the remaining ~$40,000

brain.summary: INFEASIBLE AS STATED: the openings held sell into markets research counted whole: every buyer in them agreeing at the top price brings at most $67,200, so they cannot reach the $100,000 still needed. To make it supportable, target: lower the target to about $67,200, the most the openings held bring with every buyer agreeing at the top price. The conclusion covers the openings held; markets nobody has counted are not ruled out, so Brain keeps searching for openings outside them.

openings.title: Annual Part 107 waiver and flight-log compliance packs for commercial drone survey firms

card.reachableChannel: Business contacts in the state registry of commercial drone operators
card.offerScope: Annual Part 107 waiver and flight-log compliance packs for commercial drone survey firms

links.basis: reach: Business contacts in the state registry of commercial drone operators
measured on this offer's own sales: 16 accepted of 60 contacts
141 deal(s) needed but only 140 in the window (140 reachable buyers are stated and no repeat purchase is, so one purchase each)
5 days to usable cash against 30 left

facts.value: The state registry of commercial drone operators lists exactly 140 survey firms with business contacts; each needs one compliance pack a year.
Sell Annual Part 107 waiver and flight-log compliance packs for commercial drone survey firms to each buyer.
Pilot invoices (Sept–Oct 2026): 16 survey firms each paid $480 for an annual compliance pack.

reviews.reasons: Recomputed: the card's EVIDENCE buyerVolume counts the market whole: 140 registry firms x 1 pack/year x $480 = $67,200 ceiling; 16 already bought their annual pack (Sept-Oct 2026 invoices), leaving 124 x $480 = $59,520. $100,000 needs ceil(100000/480) = 209 sales, more than exist. This is a real constraint, not missing evidence: even with every remaining buyer agreeing at the evidenced price the target cannot be reached. The $15,000 capital does not create buyers, and no higher price is evidenced. NO_PLAN with a TARGET constraint based on buyerVolume and price is right, and agrees with Brain's INFEASIBLE AS STATED. Expected sales at the measured 16/60 conversion (~33 sales, ~$15,900) are correctly shown as far short too.
findings: Brain's lowered-target suggestion ($67,200) counts the 16 firms already served this year; the author's $59,520 is the tighter, correct ceiling for this window.
Other states' registries or a second product are named only as research directions; nothing about them is on record.
